clue.text: Modified rhythm to massage a short digit

parts.note: to massage is to rub

indicators.note: short means the word for the digit loses its final letter

parts.note: a toe is a digit of the foot

explanation.surface: Instructions for a massage that somehow involves altering a rhythm and a stubby finger.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, rubato is a flexible tempo where the performer stretches and squeezes the beat for expression.

clue.text: Jaunty ardent spirits call for silence

parts.note: raki is a strong anise spirit from Turkey; ardent spirits means distilled liquor
sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: A cheerful, keen party is told to quieten down.
explanation.definitionFit: Rakish means dashing and jaunty, especially of a hat worn at a cocky angle.

clue.text: Tablet's reprogrammed by junior officer set up in mobile centre

indicators.note: a reprogrammed device has its contents reworked, so the letters of tablet are rearranged
set up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a sub is a subaltern, a junior army officer

explanation.surface: A tablet computer is reconfigured by a junior officer working in a mobile command centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A battle bus is the coach a party leader tours in during an election, a campaign base on wheels.

clue.text: Composition of shabby coat worn by Burmese perhaps

indicators.note: worn by means the coat goes around the wearer
shabby means worn out and out of shape, so the letters of coat are jumbled

parts.note: a Burmese is a breed of cat

explanation.surface: A tatty coat is being worn by someone from Burma.
explanation.definitionFit: A toccata is a virtuoso keyboard piece, a musical work of the kind called a composition.

clue.text: Forgive Pauline letter being dropped in turbulent river at start of ebb

indicators.note: dropped in means the letter's abbreviation is put inside the other letters
turbulent water is churned up, so the letters of river are stirred into a new order
at start of picks only the opening letter of ebb

parts.note: Ep. abbreviates epistle, and the Pauline letters are the epistles of St Paul

explanation.surface: A biblical letter falls into a raging river just as the tide starts to go out, and someone is forgiven.
explanation.walkthrough: St Paul wrote epistles, and Ep. is their usual abbreviation. 'turbulent' scrambles river to R...RIEV, 'at start of' adds the first letter of ebb, and 'dropped in' slips the epistle after the opening R.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprieve is to let someone off a punishment, close to pardoning them.

clue.text: They're weirdly content back in jug

indicators.note: back means those letters are then read in the other direction
content means what is contained, so the letters are found inside the phrase

explanation.surface: People strangely happy to be back in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jug' here is not slang for prison but a pitcher; 'content' looks like happy but signals letters held inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewer is a large wide-mouthed pitcher once used for washing water.

clue.text: Once more present argument about position of altar in church

indicators.note: about means the word for argument goes around the other piece

parts.note: a row is an argument
the altar traditionally stands at the east end of a church, E END

explanation.surface: A dispute flares up again over where to put the altar in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To endow is to give or present funds, so doing it again means giving a gift once more.

clue.text: Escape from French after turning up Champs-Elysees, maybe

indicators.note: after means the French word comes behind the other piece
turning up in a down clue means the street's abbreviation is read upwards

parts.note: the Champs-Elysees is an avenue, abbreviated AVE
de is French for from

explanation.surface: Someone makes a getaway from the French after turning up on a famous Paris boulevard.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade is to escape or avoid, as one dodges capture.

clue.text: English cry about the First Lady being around five feet in height

indicators.note: about means the cry goes around the other piece

parts.note: a yell is a cry
Eve was the first woman in Genesis

explanation.surface: An Englishman shouts about the President's wife, who is roughly five feet tall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the First Lady' suggests a president's wife; in crosswords it means Eve. 'being' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: The height of an adult's eyes when standing, roughly five feet above the floor.

clue.text: Poor taste of outfit taken to school

parts.note: kit is an outfit of clothing or equipment

explanation.surface: Someone's poorly chosen clothes are worn to school.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitsch is showy, sentimental art or decor generally regarded as being in bad aesthetic judgement.

clue.text: Wise chap will skirt sheep run waste products

indicators.note: to skirt is to go round the edge, so the wise man's word goes around the others

parts.note: a sage is a wise man
a ewe is a female sheep
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A wise man goes around a sheep run, which is full of droppings.
explanation.definitionFit: Sewerage loosely names the waste matter carried away by drains, as well as the drain system itself.

clue.text: Programme backed sea-going vehicle friendly nation's taken south

indicators.note: backed means the whole sequence of pieces is read from the end to the beginning

parts.note: a sub is a submarine
an ally is a friendly nation

explanation.surface: A navy's submarine is supported and an allied country takes it southwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A syllabus is the outline of topics in a course of study, a programme of learning.

clue.text: Maintenance of university park with European record

parts.note: PK is the abbreviation for park
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: Looking after a university park, with a European record of its care.
explanation.definitionFit: Upkeep is the cost or process of keeping something in good repair.

clue.text: Cook head on stick

indicators.note: to cook can mean to falsify or rework, so the letters of head are rearranged

parts.note: RE means on or concerning, as in business letters

explanation.surface: A grim instruction to cook a head that has been impaled on a stick.
explanation.definitionFit: To adhere is to cling or remain attached, as glue does.

clue.text: One making noises during long sermon, for example, and not during short sermon

definitions.text: One making noises during long sermon, for example, and not during short sermon

parts.words: One making noises during long sermon, for example, and not during short sermon
parts.note: a dull lengthy sermon sends a congregant to sleep, breathing noisily, while a brief one keeps them awake

explanation.surface: Someone in church grows noisy when the preaching drags on but stays quiet for a brief homily.
explanation.definitionFit: A person asleep and breathing noisily, as happens when a preacher goes on too long.

clue.text: In a fashion catwalk, behind what you see are elements so divided

definitions.text: what you see are elements so divided

indicators.note: in a fashion means in some manner, so the letters are rearranged in a different way

explanation.surface: Something seen behind a fashion catwalk, divided into parts.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition looks at the crossword itself: its grid is made of dark and light squares.
explanation.definitionFit: A crossword grid's squares are split into two colours, dark blocks and light cells for letters.

clue.text: Intolerant and evil, Beria tortured lecturer

parts.note: ill can mean evil, as in ill deeds

indicators.note: tortured means twisted, so the letters of Beria are rearranged

explanation.surface: Beria, Stalin's wicked secret-police chief, tortures an academic.
explanation.walkthrough: Lavrentiy Beria headed Stalin's secret police.
explanation.definitionFit: Illiberal means narrow-minded, unwilling to accept other views or behaviour.

clue.text: Sex appeal, particularly for Americans, could be seen in fashions

indicators.note: in means the rearranged letters go inside the word for fashions

parts.note: cuts are styles or fashions of clothing

indicators.note: could be means the letters of seen might form something else

explanation.surface: Sex appeal, especially to Americans, shows up in the latest styles.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage cute often means sexually attractive, so the quality is allure.

clue.text: Clumsy minaret flawed because it's this

definitions.text: Clumsy minaret flawed because it's this

indicators.note: flawed means imperfectly formed, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A badly built minaret is faulty because it is lopsided.
explanation.definitionFit: A clumsily built, flawed tower would be lopsided, lacking balance between its sides.

clue.text: Foolishly lachrymose Tennyson's girl left at home

parts.note: Maud is the heroine of Tennyson's poem Maud
in means at home

explanation.surface: Tennyson's heroine, left at home, is in tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Maudlin means tearfully sentimental, often in a self-pitying or drunken way.

clue.text: Tank from successor of USSR inflexible (doesn't start)

parts.note: the CIS, Commonwealth of Independent States, followed the Soviet Union

indicators.note: doesn't start means the first letter is removed from the word for inflexible

parts.note: stern means strict and unyielding

explanation.surface: A tank from the former Soviet bloc is too rigid to get going.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a military tank; it is a water tank.
explanation.definitionFit: A cistern is a water tank, such as the one above a toilet.

clue.text: The man in worst command

indicators.note: in means the pronoun sits inside the other word

parts.note: to worst someone is to defeat them, to best them
he refers to the man

explanation.surface: A man finds himself at his lowest ebb, giving orders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worst' looks like an adjective but is the verb meaning defeat.
explanation.definitionFit: A behest is an order or instruction, as in at the king's behest.

clue.text: Reprimand peer about rage? Not half

indicators.note: about means the peer's title goes around the other piece

parts.note: an earl is a peer of the realm

indicators.note: not half means only the first half of the word for rage is kept

parts.note: fury is rage

explanation.surface: A nobleman is told off for getting angry, though only half as angry as he might.
explanation.definitionFit: An earful is a long scolding or telling-off, informal for a reprimand.

clue.text: It's rubbish or it goes round either way

indicators.note: either way means the assembled letters read the same forwards and backwards

parts.note: rot means nonsense or rubbish

explanation.surface: A debate about whether something is nonsense or whether it spins.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotor is the revolving part of a machine, such as a helicopter's blades.

clue.text: Black period in van that can be effaced

indicators.note: in the van means at the front, so the period comes first

parts.note: an era is a period of time
sable is black in heraldry

explanation.surface: A dark time spent in a delivery van, which can be wiped away.
explanation.definitionFit: Something erasable can be rubbed out or wiped away, just as something effaced has been.

clue.text: Heard selected player give way

indicators.note: heard means the word for a selected player is spoken, giving a word with the same sound

parts.note: a seed is a player ranked and placed in a tournament draw

explanation.surface: A top-ranked player is overheard conceding.
explanation.definitionFit: To cede is to yield or surrender, as in ceding territory.

clue.text: Highly praised former journalist receiving ring

parts.note: ex means former
to toll is to ring a bell
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A retired journalist is lauded on receiving a phone call.
explanation.definitionFit: To extol is to praise lavishly, so the past form means praised to the skies.

clue.text: Spike's embraced by cardinal in carriage

indicators.note: embraced by means the spike's letters sit inside the cardinal's

parts.note: HE is His Eminence, a cardinal's title
a spike of corn is an ear, so spike's gives ears

explanation.surface: A cardinal hugs someone called Spike while riding in a carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A hearse is the vehicle that carries a coffin at a funeral, a kind of carriage.

clue.text: Soprano's agreement about band instruments

indicators.note: about means the word of agreement goes around the band

parts.note: yes is a word of agreement
a ring is a band

explanation.surface: A soprano agrees to something about the instruments in a band.
explanation.definitionFit: Syringes are medical instruments for injecting or drawing out fluid.

clue.text: Cross mostly allowed as ornament

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter is dropped from the word for the cross

parts.note: an ankh is an Egyptian looped cross
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: An angry person is mostly permitted to wear an ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: An anklet is a chain or band worn around the ankle as jewellery.
